messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "narrowing of the stomach or intestines"
set: ["narrowing of the stomach or intestines", "blockage in stomach or intestines", "damage to stomach or intestines", "narrowing of the airways", "known or suspected blockage of stomach or intestines", "narrowing of the airways in the lungs", "narrowing of the air passages in the lungs due to exercise", "history of bleeding in the stomach or bowel", "reducing glucose absorption from the intestines", "decreasing the amount of acid the stomach produces", "ulcers in the stomach", "irritate the stomach lining", "signs of stomach bleeding", "raise the risk of stomach ulcers and bleeding", "stomach or intestinal disorder", "stomach or intestinal bleeding"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
